Bihar STET Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released a Notification for the Bihar State Teacher Eligibility STET Examination 2026 on the official website of the BSEB. Applications for the Bihar STET Online Form 2026 has Started from 17 August 2026 & Candidate can apply untill 15 September 2026 (Extended). Candidates can Check full details of Bihar STET Online Form 2026 which given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 August 2026
  • Last Date : 15 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 September 2026
  • Exam Start : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam
  • Result : will be updated here soon

Application Fee

  • Paper I or Paper II
  • General, EWS, BC, EBC : Rs. 960/-
  • Other State (All Category) : Rs. 960/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 760/-
  • Both Paper I & II
  • General, EWS, BC, EBC: Rs. 1440/-
  • Other State (All Category): Rs. 1440/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 1140/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
